task_reconstruction.official_task: Build a sustainability index, identify a country, and project a 20-year development plan.

section_map.summary: Summary states the objective, three assumptions and the Bhutan result.
Methodology defines six subindices on a 0 to 10 scale.
Results compare eight countries and open the Bhutan case.
Parameter table projects each indicator to 2035.
Strengths and weaknesses name the unused scale and the uncontrollable factors.

contributions.summary: Six stability subindices on one scale with a stated unsustainable threshold of 5.0.
A 20-year projection that changes only the parameters the plan can move.

assumptions.summary: Subindex parameters are uniform across the dataset.
All factors inside one subindex are weighted equally.

data_and_preprocessing.summary: Yale Environmental Performance Index, 2014, for climate, air, forest, fisheries and habitat.

models.summary: Environmental index with particulate counted twice.

verification.summary: Eight countries plotted on one radar chart to test whether the index separates them.
Bhutan bracketed between Iceland and Nigeria.

results_trace.summary: Bhutan institutional index 4.1, from unpaved roads, corruption and schooling.
Bhutan social index 5.1, from refugees and gender inequality.
Bhutan political index 4.7, from ethnic tension and cross-border camps.
Environmental score is the only sector not improved by 2035.

writing_logic.summary: Objective, then assumptions, then method, then the case and its direction.
Each projected parameter gets current value, predicted value and a reason.

language_observations.summary: The summary opens on the objective, not the topic.
A score is followed by the components that produced it.
The one sector that does not improve is named.

visualization_observations.summary: Figure 1 plots eight countries on one radar chart with a shared axis.
Figure 2 brackets Bhutan between Iceland and Nigeria.
Figure 3 overlays Bhutan now and Bhutan in 2035.

judge_relevance_hypotheses.summary: The parameter table makes the projection traceable.

independent_extensions.summary: Weight the indicators instead of averaging them, and recompute the ranking.

candidate_rule_impacts.impact: Six subindices built from published indicators with stated transforms.
Every indicator cites its publisher and year.
The 20-year plan changes only the parameters it can move.
Three assumptions stated before the formula.
The index is compared across eight countries and two benchmarks.

unresolved_questions: The printed formulas are images; the recorded equations are reconstructed from the prose.
